ordinary.source:
def public(session, other):
    performing = getattr(session, "release_token", None)
    answer = performing(other)
    return answer["kind"]

argument_rebinds_alias.source:
def public(session, other):
    performing = getattr(session, "release_token", None)
    answer = performing((performing := other))
    return answer["kind"]

delete_attribute_keeps_callable.source:
def public(session):
    performing = getattr(session, "release_token", None)
    del performing.cached
    return performing({})["kind"]

delete_subscript_keeps_callable.source:
def public(session, other):
    performing = getattr(session, "release_token", None)
    del other[performing]
    return performing({})["kind"]

delete_binding_kills_callable.source:
def public(session):
    performing = getattr(session, "release_token", None)
    del performing
    return performing({})["kind"]

keyword_rebinding_current_and_later.source:
def public(session, other):
    performing = getattr(session, "release_token", None)
    answer = performing(key=(performing := other))
    return answer["kind"], performing({})["wrong"]

augmented_rhs_before_rebinding.source:
def public(session):
    performing = getattr(session, "release_token", None)
    performing += performing({})["kind"]
    return performing({})["wrong"]
